annotations.title: List subtitle lines with their speaker

description: For a multi_speaker localize_video job: every source subtitle line with block_id, time, detected speaker and (after translation) the translated line. Use it when speaker detection looks wrong (fewer speakers than characters, a child merged with an adult, a line given to the wrong person): read the lines, work out who says each one from the story, then fix them with set_speaker_lines before set_speaker_voices.
